text:
maria: Heads-up — we need to rotate the prod deploy key and do a hotfix now. Shared deployer key expired and CI can't push. Requesting breakglass JIT for 10m to land a critical memory-leak fix in the inference runtime. @deploy-bot please create an approval, @oncall-sre can you take a look?

deploy-bot: Permission request created: #4923 by @maria. Details: breakglass (deploy), ttl=600s, reason='hotfix: runtime OOM leak'. To approve: react :thumbsup: or run `/approve 4923`. Audit log will be kept.

alex: which key got rotated? is this for all regions? any pinned version we should be aware of?

maria: the shared deployer key used by CI was rotated yesterday (compromise suspicion). This hotfix targets runtime v1.24.7 -> new image v1.24.8. We need to pin after deploy if successful. Canary in us-west1 first.

sam: ops policy reminder: prod deploys require (1) member of `deployer` group, (2) MFA enrolled, (3) release lead signoff. Breakglass allowed but needs oncall approval + full audit. Jordan, can you be release lead?

jordan: I can sign as release lead but my MFA isn't enrolled on the new auth flow yet. Getting SMS MFA won't meet policy. How quickly can I get enrolled?

oncall-sre: I can approve the JIT but need a quick checklist recorded: steps, rollback command, where audit logs go. I'll approve once those are posted.

maria: checklist below. I'm attaching quick commands:```
# grant JIT (authctl)
authctl grant --sid=jordan --role=deployer --ttl=600 --reason="hotfix memory leak"
# deploy canary
rdctl deploy runtime --image=runtime:v1.24.8 --region=us-west1 --replicas=2 --canary
# rollback (if bad)
rdctl rollout pin runtime --image=runtime:v1.24.6
```

alex: add a quick smoke test after canary: `curl -sS https://us-west1-api.redwood/v1/health | jq .mem_rss` check for steady mem usage. Also tag the release notes: `release-notes: runtime: fix OOM on long sessions`

liz: audit destination: s3://redwood-prod-audit/deploys/1717324567/ — please push the deploy log and the auth grant json there. I'll verify retention policy. :lock:

sam: recommend `traffic-shift 10% -> 50% -> 100%` over 10m intervals, plus a 5m prometheus burn-in alert threshold. If any alert, auto-roll back to v1.24.6.

jordan: authctl granted, MFA enrollment flow started (will finish in ~3m). @oncall-sre you can approve now if you want me to press the button after MFA finalizes.

oncall-sre: Reacting :thumbsup: to #4923. Approving limited JIT for 10m. Recording approval in audit. Please proceed with canary only, no global rollout until I confirm metrics.

deploy-bot: Approval recorded: approver=oncall-sre, request=4923, ttl=600s. Audit event id=evt-0a7f23.

maria: Starting canary now. Pushing image v1.24.8 to us-west1 (2 pods). Will run smoke tests.

alex: smoke tests pass on canary (mem stable after 15m). No new OOMs.

maria: shifting 50% now, monitoring.

sam: metrics look good. CPU/mem stable. No error spike in 5m. Golive when oncall gives final ok.

oncall-sre: Looks clean on observability. Approving full rollout, please pin revision afterwards and upload release notes.

maria: Pinned to v1.24.8 and uploaded notes: `runtime: v1.24.8 — fix memory leak in KV cache, reduces OOMs for long sessions`. Logs + auth grant pushed to s3 path liz mentioned. Closing #4923.

deploy-bot: Request #4923 closed by @maria. Events: created -> approved -> executed -> closed. Audit path: s3://redwood-prod-audit/deploys/1717324567/evt-0a7f23.json

maria: Hotfix deployed and pinned. Thanks @oncall-sre, @jordan, @alex, @sam, @liz. Will follow up with a quick postmortem on the key rotation and next steps to avoid future emergency breakglass. :white_check_mark:
